title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode2 What's Needed for the Event

meta.Episode: Episode2 — What's Needed for the Event
meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, what about this place?
It looks so new and sparkly! And it's right by the station!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is, but this would put us over the budget too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
You two are here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning!
Let's make practice a good one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You seem awfully excited, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
You're just overflowing with enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because I am! I've been coming up with all sorts of ideas for our event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great!
Be sure to tell us about them once we have a venue picked out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, what were you two just talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were looking for some candidate venues. We felt bad about having Hayakawa doing everything for us, and it's a good opportunity to learn more about the venues around here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we still haven't found a good place for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
We actually tried looking for some staffing agencies that might be able to help us yesterday too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You did?
Did either of you have any luck?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we have some candidates, but things get pretty expensive around this time of year...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The increase in demand for all the events taking place between Christmas and New Year's in turn also causes prices to increase...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Money, huh...
Even after we talked about what kinds of things we want to do as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but that discussion also came attached with each of being able to “pay our fair share”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, putting on an event is a completely different story...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Booking a venue and hiring staff alone costs a lot of money...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what if I take all the money I've made from working and spend it here...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? “All,” you say?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Well... A little, maybe... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's really starting to sound like we won't have enough, I could put in more and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No! We already discussed that, didn't we? We each pay our fair share.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm pretty sure that we've also talked about how it's not a good idea to make some work more than others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay. Right...
Thanks, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With regards to booking a venue and staffing, we'll just have to wait for Nanamin to get back to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand. Hayakawa did mention that she needed to stop by her agency yesterday to discuss another matter...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right on cue...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. This is Kiritani speaking.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
<Hey, Haruka?
Sorry for not getting back to you sooner! Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, we can talk.
So... How'd everything go?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: <Yeah, about that...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you so much!
You've been a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I guess we don't really have a choice. I'll discuss that with the others...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we really appreciate it. Again, thank you so much. Okay, talk to you later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What'd she say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She said they found a good venue for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, her agency can apparently book this 500-person hall they use from time to time at a discounted rate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On Christmas Day no less...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! On Christmas Day?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Every venue's usually booked with some kind of event on Christmas...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Based on what Hayakawa just said, her agency originally had it booked for another event, but they ran into some trouble and had to cancel it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This venue was looking for another act to fill that vacancy since they would ultimately be the ones taking the most damage from that happening.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We really get to put on a Christmas event...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, hold your horses!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, Haruka, you seemed a little concerned towards the end of that conversation.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, well... It sounds like Hayakawa can take care of booking a venue for us that's also within our budget...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But hiring a staff for our event is going to be a challenge.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, there are events of all shapes and sizes being held this time of year, which causes a shortage in supply in terms of event staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about what we should do since Hayakawa's agency won't be able to help us there and how expensive it is to hire through another company...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These venues usually have their own lighting and sound technicians, but we're gonna need more than that if we're really gonna do a fan meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need receptionists, people to organize lines, check tickets and such.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. Our fans seem to be expecting quite a bit from us, so we're probably going to need extra hands for other activities besides just the meet and greet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
There's no event without any event staff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's try looking for people who might be able to fill that role!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look for them? How?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like, um... Asking our friends to help us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a wonderful idea!
I'll try asking around as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see... That could actually work.
I'll see if anyone in the tea ceremony club can lend us a hand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Our friends...
I feel a little bad about asking someone to help us like this on Christmas Day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure some already have plans, but I suppose there's no harm in asking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll start by asking Kohane!
After school

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-They all have plans...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're all going out with their friends or seeing Christmas events and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You too, huh, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was told the same thing.
My friends from club all made plans with their friends or family already.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Same. My classmates said they can't come because they're throwing a Christmas party.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tis the season so I guess it's to be expected...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We might not have any other choice but to increase our budget and hire people from a staffing agency...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try looking again to see if there's a company that can help us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hey...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? What is it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our MORE MORE JUMP! account got an email from someone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? An email?
